objective: Move the active Oyatie mockup closer to a complete Bominal-grade product by filling shallow Money/Finance rail destinations and removing the noisy selective-WASM package 404 fallback from the live dashboard.

findings_addressed: ledger-preview was present in navigation but shallow or missing as a full rendered finance surface
vendors/spend, billing/tax, and leave/time were nav-level expectations without matching deep product views
live SSR shell emitted a browser console 404 while probing /pkg/oya_application_shell_frontend_prototype.js before falling back to prototype-interactions.js

implemented: Added a cohesive Finance Commercial Suite after Identity + Workforce, covering ledger close, vendors/spend, billing/tax, and leave/time liability as one product surface rather than disconnected cards.
Added Bominal-like dense Money rail destinations: Vendors & spend and Billing & tax, and rerouted Employees to the deep identity employee directory.
Added ledger close cockpit with close KPIs, reconciliation bars, journal table, close provenance, and local notifications.
Added vendor spend control with vendor search, risk/renewal/owner table, local vendor draft creation, and side-peek-compatible vendor inspection.
Added billing/tax workspace with revenue, filing, and plan-change cards, plus local invoice/tax brief actions.
Added leave/time liability workspace tied to payroll cutoff, overtime risk, and leave approvals with local preview actions.
Added finance command-palette action and hash-addressable deep states for #ledger-preview, #vendors-spend, #billing-tax, and #leave-time.

Changed SSR root script to render a server-derived wasmPackageAvailable flag instead of directly importing /pkg; the visual fallback now mounts without a browser console 404 when cargo-leptos pkg assets are absent.

observations: SSR output sets wasmPackageAvailable = false in the current container rather than attempting a direct failing import
Captured finance ledger, vendors, billing, leave/time, and command palette states at 1440x900.
Screenshots show the missing Money rail destinations now resolve to a cohesive product surface.

visual_verdict.category_match: Bominal-style dense enterprise finance and operations control surface integrated into Oyatie's command-center shell
visual_verdict.verdict: This slice passes the Visual Ralph threshold for the previously shallow finance/money destinations and improves runtime polish by removing the noisy fallback 404. It is an integrated Oyatie product suite, not a literal Bominal clone.
improved_matches: Money rail destinations now have deep surfaces for ledger, vendors/spend, billing/tax, and leave/time.
Finance content uses dense tables, compact rail, KPI strip, close provenance, Korean payroll/tax context, and low-radius neutral Bominal-derived styling.
Finance actions are visually functional and update local state/status without pretending to be wired to real systems.
Command palette exposes Finance Control alongside workflow, identity, mail, community, policy, inventory, audit, and deployment gates.
Browser runtime has no console errors or failed responses in the current live Podman smoke after replacing direct /pkg import with server-derived wasm availability.
remaining_differences: The suite is still visual/local-only and intentionally does not move money, send invoices, submit taxes, create real vendors, approve payroll, or write HR/time records.
Bominal has separate routed pages; this pass continues the cohesive Oyatie in-dashboard integration strategy requested by the user.
Exact Bominal iconography and some page-specific whitespace are approximated rather than cloned.

non_claims: No real banking, billing, tax, vendor, payroll, or leave/time mutation occurs.
No external messages, invoices, filings, or payment rails are contacted.
No production persistence is claimed beyond local DOM state in the mockup.
This does not complete every future Oyatie route; it materially closes the finance/money/product-depth gap toward the complete mockup objective.
